verdict.rationale: Parsec for Teams is a SaaS remote-access platform with an admin API, so outbound event webhooks are a fair axis for it. The evidence only documents a Teams API for deployment automation and pulling audit logs, which is a building block a consumer would have to poll, not registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. No webhook subscription capability is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
